the perceived usefulness (PU), perceived ease (PE), and environmental concern (EC) affect significantly on attitude (AT), and attitude (AT), subjective norm (SN), moral obligation (MO), and perceived behavioral control (PBC) affect significantly on behavioral intention (BI).
paddy farmer's perception on organic farming technology, environmental concern and moral obligation have a significant impact on attitude and behavioral intention toward organic rice farming.

paddy farmer's perception, attitude and intention to adoption of organic rice technology are significantly influenced by perceived usefulness, perceived easy, environmental concern, subjective norm, attitude, moral obligation and control behavior.

farmers' perceptions and factors affecting their attitude and behavioral intention toward adopting organic rice technology.
the factors that affect the attitude and intention to organic rice farming adoption.
the perceptions of paddymen on organic rice farming.

paddy farmer’s perception and factors influencing the attitude and intention to organic rice farming in Sragen District are influenced significantly by perceived ease, usefulness, subjective norm, perceived behavioral control, and moral obligation.

the adoption of organic farming is a complex process, which involves the farmers’ perceptions and attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control.
organic rice farming is a solution that is worth to be implemented in Indonesia.

farmers' perception on organic rice technology and environmental concern are important in determining the adoption of organic rice technology.
